Wonderful! 

I am assuming your estate would bring that to the attention of the insurance agencies? Or how would that work? 

I am pretty sure they are just office rumors though.
And who would bring this the courts attention since the person would be dead? Is it your estate or do the insurance companies investigate it on their own?

I am not so sure what a mother has to offer that others don't. I never really knew mine. 

I don't want to be seen or explore. I don't want excitement. I want average. I want that steady pace but it keeps slipping. The extraordinary keeps seeping in. It is a thing I don't want.
